iWant: my passwords and keys kept in my Mac's Keychain and fetched only when a tool needs them
soThat: a secret of mine never lands in a file, a chat, a backup or a ticket, and is never shown
description: A secret is first stored through a Mac dialog with a hidden field, never typed into the chat, and later fetched by Squire's secret helper at the moment a tool needs it. These rules are core's and cannot be overlaid.
title: Secrets: kept in the Keychain, fetched at the moment of use, never shown

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Squire owner's passwords and keys stay in the Mac's Keychain and never appear in a file, a chat or a ticket.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A secret stored through Squire, and Squire used across its normal work. Core's safety rules apply whatever the Squire owner's folder holds; an overlay there cannot change them.
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Squire owner's folder, the conversation history and transcripts, the pages Squire made, the backups and the tickets are scanned for the secret
acceptanceCriteria.then: The secret is in the Mac's Keychain and nowhere else.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Secrets are fetched when needed and never shown.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A secret in the Mac's Keychain that a tool needs. Core's safety rules apply whatever the Squire owner's folder holds; an overlay there cannot change them.
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire's secret helper fetches it and the tool that needs it runs
acceptanceCriteria.then: The tool gets the secret, and neither the helper's output nor the tool's output holds any trace of it.
